# Energix US Brings 152 MWdc Border Basin Solar Project Online with Stem’s PowerTrack Platform


November 03, 2026 8:00am EST


*PowerTrack Now Operational at Utility-Scale Power Plant in Hancock County, Ohio, Serving the PJM Market*


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Stem, Inc. (NYSE: STEM), a global leader in AI-enabled clean energy software and services, today announced the successful deployment of its PowerTrack™ Platform at Border Basin Solar, a 152 MWdc (120 MWac) utility-scale solar project, owned and developed by Energix US, LLC. Border Basin is now operational and delivering clean energy into the PJM Interconnection market.


Stem supported the project from conceptual design to factory preparation through commissioning and operator handoff. By combining upfront engineering, panel shop assembly and pre-configuration, Factory Acceptance Testing, on-site commissioning, utility witness testing, and remote support, Stem helped bring the facility online with full visibility from day one.


“For utility-scale developers like Energix, bringing a project online is only part of the equation. Long-term success depends on reliable operations, clear visibility into asset performance, and the right technical support,” said Matt Tappin, President of Software at Stem. “We’re proud to support Energix as they continue to expand their solar portfolio and focus on maximizing the performance and long-term value of their assets.”


PowerTrack now serves as power plant control, data acquisition and monitoring backbone for Border Basin. Stem’s scope included PJMnet integration, power plant controls, local SCADA, communications and networking hardware, meteorological stations, and PowerTrack Software for cloud-based monitoring, performance analytics, alerting, reporting, and remote data backup.


“Border Basin is an important milestone for Energix as we surpass 1GW in our U.S. portfolio in the PJM market,” said Zvi Tvizer, Country Manager and COO at Energix Renewables. “Stem’s PowerTrack platform gives our operations team the real-time visibility and performance insight we need to maximize production and ensure reliable, long-term operation of the facility.”


For more information on Stem and the PowerTrack, visit stem.com.


**About Stem**


Stem (NYSE: STEM) is a global leader reimagining technology to support the energy transition. We turn complexity into clarity and potential into performance.


Stem helps asset owners, operators, and energy stakeholders unlock the full value of their portfolios by enabling the intelligent development, deployment, and operation of clean energy assets. Stem’s integrated software suite, PowerTrack™, is the industry-standard and best-in-class platform for asset monitoring and optimization and is backed by expert professional and managed services, all delivered under one roof. Designed to address complex energy challenges seamlessly, our technology transforms raw data into clear, actionable insights, providing the visibility and intelligence needed to drive performance. With projects across 55 countries, customers have trusted Stem for nearly 20 years to maximize the value of their clean energy investments.


Driven by human and artificial intelligence, Stem is unlocking energy intelligence. Learn more at stem.com.


**About Energix Renewables**


Energix Renewables is an independent power producer (IPP) that develops, constructs, owns, and operates renewable energy projects across their entire lifecycle. This integrated approach makes Energix a reliable partner at every stage and a distinctive player in the market. Leveraging financial strength and extensive project experience, Energix builds projects that create long-term value for local communities, landowners, stakeholders, and the environment. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Energix Renewables is among the leading solar energy producers in the Mid-Atlantic region. Active in the U.S. market since 2016, Energix is one of the largest actors in the PV market in Virginia and Pennsylvania, with rapid expansion into neighboring states.
